acceptance.gate: Phase 5 gate G5 per master-plan v2.1 §9: u_y within 1% of 6.98946 mm.

boundary_conditions.load: upward resultant shear load P_y applied to the right face; loaded upper corner is the displacement-probe location

formulation.continuity: displacement continuity reduced by one from maximum (C^(p-2)-type U space); each fine pressure cell carries one discontinuous constant
formulation.material_law: NLGEOM=OFF → in-house isotropic linear elasticity; NLGEOM=ON → in-house compressible Neo-Hookean (selected per-element-call kinematics; plasticity NOT supported for locking-free UEL elements)
formulation.pressure: independent pressure field for the volumetric response, weak/averaged constraint; pressure coefficients statically condensed (no global pressure DOFs); NO GLS/SUPG/VMS/pressure-gradient stabilization by default
formulation.type: locking-free U(p,C^(p-2),h)/P(0,C^(-1),h); immersed pressure-cell aggregation with nearby admissible donor (cut-cell treatment separate from residual stabilization)

loads.note: Coreform doc states 'resultant shear load P_y = 6.25 N', but the benchmark reference u_y = 6.98946 mm corresponds to 6.25 N/mm^2 (MPa) uniform shear traction over the 16 x 1.91516 mm right face (resultant 191.516 N); a 6.25 N resultant yields ~0.229 mm.

materials.type: nearly incompressible; compressible Neo-Hookean (Coreform in-house) under NLGEOM=ON

mesh_sweep.discretization: quadratic BODY-FITTED Cook's membrane model (immersed variant discussed only as alpha with aggregation cost caveats)
mesh_sweep.unknown_note: Background/body-fitted mesh sizes, refinement levels and DOF counts were not captured from the crawled sections. Re-read the mesh/job sections of the source page before use.

provenance.reference_doc_sections: plan-view geometry + BC figure, property list (L, H_L, H_R, Δy, t, E, ν, P_y, NLGEOM), formulation §2, activation (USE_LOCKING_FREE=1), §5 expected result

reference_values.note: Scalar probe value at the loaded upper corner over the nonlinear load step (Fig. 2 in source). No full-field CSVs accompany this example in generated-downloads.
